description: This file is a Lua script that provides utility functions for importing external files, minifying CSS sources, and dynamically injecting CSS into a webpage. It defines functions to read files, concatenate minified CSS, and create style elements in the DOM.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Reads the content of a file at the given path.

methods.name: luax.css
methods.description: Generates a style tag with concatenated, minified CSS sources and injects it into the document head.
